units.source_text: 这些画都特别富有意趣，因此皇上又到弘徽殿来看画了。

en.t: These paintings were all especially full of charm, so the Emperor came again to the Kokiden to look at them.

units.source_text: 但权中纳言不肯轻易拿出去给他看。

en.t: But the Acting Middle Counselor would not readily bring them out for him to see.

units.source_text: 他舍不得让皇上拿去给梅壶女御看，因此藏得很好。

en.t: He could not bear to let the Emperor take them away and show them to the lady of the Plum Pavilion, so he kept them carefully hidden.

units.source_text: 源氏内大臣闻知此事，笑道：“权中纳言的孩子脾气还是不改呢！”

en.t: When Genji, the Inner Minister, heard of this, he laughed and said, "The Acting Middle Counselor still has not outgrown his childish ways!"

units.source_text: 又向冷泉帝奏道：“他只管把画藏好，不肯爽爽快快地呈请御览，以致恼乱圣心，实甚不该！

en.t: He also reported to Emperor Reizei, "He only keeps the paintings hidden away and refuses to present them openly for Your Majesty's viewing, thereby troubling the imperial heart. It is truly most improper!

units.source_text: 臣有家藏古画，当即取来奉献。”

en.t: I have old paintings preserved at my house, and I shall fetch them at once and offer them to you."

units.source_text: 便回到二条院，把保藏新旧画幅的橱子打开，与紫姬二人共同选择。

en.t: He then returned to the Nijo residence, opened the cabinet where old and new picture scrolls were stored, and chose them together with Lady Murasaki.

units.source_text: 凡新颖可喜之种种作品，尽行取出。

en.t: He took out every work that seemed fresh, pleasing, and delightful.

units.source_text: 惟描写长恨歌与王昭君的画，虽然富有趣味，意义未免不祥，故此次决定不予选用。

en.t: Only the paintings depicting The Song of Everlasting Sorrow and Wang Zhaojun, though rich in interest, were considered rather ill-omened in meaning, so he decided not to select them this time.

units.source_text: 源氏内大臣乘此机会，把保藏须磨、明石旅中图画日记的箱子也打开，好让紫姬也看看这些画。

en.t: Taking this opportunity, Genji, the Inner Minister, also opened the box that held his illustrated travel diaries from Suma and Akashi, so that Lady Murasaki could see those pictures as well.
